meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会当你的写作搭档:帮你把想法整理成大纲、查找资料并加引用、改进开头 hook、逐段给反馈,同时保留你自己的写作风格和语气。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章或技术文档,或想让 Claude 帮忙搭大纲、改开头、逐段给反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这篇关于 XX 的文章搭一个大纲
say.note: 会先问主题、受众和写作目标,再给结构

say.text: 这是我的开头,帮我让 hook 更抓人
say.note: 先分析现有开头,再给几个替代版本

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么重要」这一节,帮我看看
say.note: 按清晰度、行文、证据、风格逐项反馈

howto.what_en: Claude acts as your writing partner: it outlines ideas with you, researches topics and adds citations, improves hooks, and gives section-by-section feedback while keeping your own voice and tone.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, or technical docs, or when you want help outlining, improving a hook, or getting feedback on a section.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about X
say_en.note: It asks about topic, audience, and goal first.

say_en.text: Here's my intro — help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes the hook, then offers alternatives.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it.
say_en.note: It covers clarity, flow, evidence, and style.
